channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Announcing Amazon ECS Gateway, a managed ingress solution for your ECS services
item.description: AWS announces Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) Gateway, a new resource that simplifies ingress networking for containerized applications by dynamically provisioning and managing Application Load Balancers (ALBs) and their… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon DynamoDB global tables now support disassociating replicas
item.description: Amazon DynamoDB global tables now support disassociating a replica without deleting its table or data. Global tables provide fully managed, multi-Region, multi-active replication. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Polly Generative engine upgraded with more natural speech, 14 new voices, and 2 new languages
item.description: Today, we are introducing a new model behind the Amazon Polly Generative engine that delivers more natural-sounding, accurate speech output with low latency. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS announces TorchNeuron: Native PyTorch Support for AWS Trainium (Public Beta)
item.description: Today, AWS launched the public beta of TorchNeuron, an open source native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Structured outputs for Claude models available on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Amazon Bedrock now supports structured outputs for all Anthropic Claude models across both the bedrock-runtime and the bedrock-mantle endpoint. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Clean Rooms now supports Databricks as a data source
item.description: AWS Clean Rooms now supports Databricks as a data source , so collaboration members and their partners can securely analyze data managed in Databricks without moving or revealing the source data. (1 source: aws)
